model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Figure 5 (left) is a line graph illustrating the proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating, with a threshold of $10^{-2}$. 

The x-axis is labeled as "Layer", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, marked in intervals of 5. 

The y-axis is labeled as "Proportion", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, marked in intervals of 0.2. 

The graph features two lines: a green line representing the proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating, and a blue line representing another related measurement. The green line starts at approximately 0.95 on the y-axis at layer 0, then decreases sharply to approximately 0.1 at layer 2, and continues to decrease gradually to approximately 0.05 at layer 20. The blue line starts at approximately 0.9 on the y-axis at layer 0, then decreases sharply to approximately 0.35 at layer 2, then decreases gradually to approximately 0.05 at layer 20. 

The graph presents a clear visual representation of the changes in proportion across different layers, allowing for a detailed examination of the trends and patterns in the data.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The figure shows the proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating with a threshold of $1e-2$. The x-axis represents the layer, with labels ranging from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5, and no units are specified. The y-axis represents the proportion, with labels ranging from 0 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.2. 

The figure contains four lines. A green dashed line represents the proportion before gate, with a value around 0.9 at layer 0 and gradually decreasing to approximately 0.1 at layer 20. A blue dashed line shows the proportion after gate, with a value around 0.5 at layer 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.05 at layer 20. A green solid line represents the proportion after average gate, with a value around 0.35 at layer 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.05 at layer 20. A blue solid line represents the proportion after average gating score with pre-gating hidden states, with a value around 0.35 at layer 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.05 at layer 20.
